user.title: Snapmaker U1
user.description: IP address or host name of the printer. Port 80 works with stock firmware, Extended Firmware and Bespok3d.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: All optional and changeable later under “Configure”. Expand the sections.

power.name: Power and energy
power.description: Any switch works: Shelly, KNX, Zigbee plug, …

data.shutdown_host: Shut the printer down before cutting power
data.auto_on: Switch on automatically when a print is started
data.auto_off: Switch off automatically after a print

data_description.power_switch: Used for the on/off button on the card. Switching off is blocked while printing.
data_description.power_sensor: Live power draw, usually from the same plug.
data_description.energy_sensor: Total energy counter. Used for the consumption of each print.
data_description.energy_price: Sensor or helper with the current price (dynamic tariffs). Empty = fixed price below or the energy dashboard.
data_description.shutdown_host: Sends a shutdown to the printer, waits until it is gone plus 10 s, then switches off. If the printer refuses, it is switched off after 10 s like with its rocker switch.
data_description.auto_on: Starting a print from the card while the printer is off switches it on and waits until it is ready (about 1–2 min).
data_description.auto_off: After a finished or cancelled print, once all heaters have cooled down.
data_description.auto_off_temp: Nozzles and bed must be below this temperature.
data_description.auto_off_delay: Minimum time between the end of the print and switching off.
data_description.idle_off_hours: Hours without a print and without heating, then shut down cleanly and switch off. 0 = off.
data_description.energy_price_fixed: Per kWh, used when no price entity is set. Without both, the price from the energy dashboard is used.

notify.name: Notifications & camera
notify.description: Phone push: print end, errors, pause, messages, first layer, almost done, low filament.

data_description.camera: The companion app attaches a current image. Also used for the result photo in the history.
data_description.bed_cool_temp: Bed temperature after a finished print at which the message is sent.
data_description.camera_wake: Sends camera.start_monitor every 10 s like the Snapmaker app. Needed if the camera image stops on stock firmware; modified firmware usually does not need it.

filament.name: Filament prices
filament.description: Price per kg by material, used for the filament cost of each print. Leave empty to skip.

data_description.config_backup: Daily copy of printer.cfg etc. to /config/snapmaker_u1_backup (only when changed, 10 versions).

spoolman.name: Spoolman
spoolman.description: Optional. Leave the URL empty if you don't use Spoolman.

data.spoolman_deduct: Deduct usage per head after each print

data_description.spoolman_url: Address with port 7912, e.g. 192.168.0.10:7912 (Home Assistant add-on: homeassistant.local:7912). Empty = off.
data_description.spoolman_deduct: Slicer weight per toolhead (pro rata when cancelled). Turn off if something else already books usage (e.g. Moonraker's own Spoolman connection), otherwise it is counted twice.
data_description.spoolman_low: Card shows a warning when a spool has less filament left.

timelapse.name: Timelapse backup
timelapse.description: Copies new timelapses to Home Assistant's media folder (snapmaker_u1). The oldest can then be deleted on the printer.

data_description.timelapse_keep: This many newest stay on the printer, older ones are deleted after the backup. 0 = never delete.
data_description.timelapse_archive_max: Newest videos kept in the media folder; older ones are deleted. 0 = keep all.

maintenance.name: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Intervals in print hours. 0 = hide item.

error.not_u1: Moonraker answered, but this is not a Snapmaker U1 (print_task_config missing).
error.auto_needs_switch: Auto-on and auto-off need a power switch.
error.unknown_notify: One of the notify services does not exist.
error.spoolman_unreachable: Spoolman is not reachable at this URL.

abort.already_configured: This printer is already set up.

start_print.name: Start print
start_print.description: Starts a print file on the printer with filament mapping, like Snapmaker Orca.

filename.name: File
filename.description: Path relative to the gcodes folder.

mapping.name: Filament mapping
mapping.description: Logical filament (T0, T1, ...) to printer slot 0-3, e.g. 0: 2 and 1: 0 as YAML mapping. Empty = automatic suggestion.

bed_leveling.name: Bed leveling
bed_leveling.description: Run automatic bed leveling before printing.

pause_layers.name: Pause before layer
pause_layers.description: List of layers (1 = first). The printer pauses before these layers, e.g. to insert magnets. A copy of the file with PAUSE is created for this.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Reload file list and filaments immediately.

wait.name: Wait until ready
wait.description: Return only when Klipper is ready (up to 4 min).

power_off.name: Power off safely
power_off.description: Shut the printer down and then switch it off. Refused while printing.

force.name: Force
force.description: Switch off even though a print is recorded as running, e.g. after the printer crashed. Not checked against the printer state.

set_spool.name: Assign spool
set_spool.description: Assigns a Spoolman spool to a toolhead. Without spool_id the integration picks automatically again.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: ID in Spoolman; 0 = no spool. Leave empty for automatic.

queue_add.name: Add to queue
queue_add.description: Plans a print with mapping and options. It is started manually (queue_start) once the bed is cleared.

filename.name: File
filename.description: Path relative to the gcodes folder.

mapping.name: Filament mapping
mapping.description: Logical filament (T0, T1, ...) to printer slot 0-3, e.g. 0: 2 and 1: 0 as YAML mapping. Empty = automatic suggestion.

bed_leveling.name: Bed leveling
bed_leveling.description: Run automatic bed leveling before printing.

pause_layers.name: Pause before layer
pause_layers.description: List of layers (1 = first). The printer pauses before these layers, e.g. to insert magnets. A copy of the file with PAUSE is created for this.

job_id.name: Job
job_id.description: ID from the jobs attribute of the queue sensor.

job_id.name: Job
job_id.description: ID from the jobs attribute of the queue sensor.

queue_start.name: Start job
queue_start.description: Starts the first (or the given) job. Clear the bed first.

maintenance_done.name: Maintenance done
maintenance_done.description: Resets the counter of a maintenance item.

backup_timelapses.name: Back up timelapses now
backup_timelapses.description: Backs up missing timelapses to the media folder, then cleans up the printer.

backup_config.name: Back up printer configuration
backup_config.description: Copies printer.cfg etc. from the printer to /config/snapmaker_u1_backup (new version only when changed).

file_details.name: File details
file_details.description: Metadata and thumbnail of a print file, including older ones (for the card's search).

path.name: File
path.description: Path relative to gcodes, e.g. parts/holder.gcode

delete_file.name: Delete file
delete_file.description: Deletes a print file on the printer. Not while it is printing or queued.

path.name: File
path.description: Path relative to gcodes, e.g. parts/holder.gcode

move_file.name: Rename/move file
move_file.description: New name or path; subfolders are created.

self_test.name: Self-test
self_test.description: Checks printer, live connection, storage, Moonraker integration, camera, power, notifications, Spoolman, Assist and media folder.

language.name: Language
language.description: de or en; empty = Home Assistant language.

set_preference.name: Set printer preference
set_preference.description: Changes a firmware preference of the printer. Possible during a print.

preference.name: Preference
preference.description: auto_replenish, replenish_ignore_color, entangle_detect, end_led_off or entangle_sensitivity.

value.name: Value
value.description: true/false; for entangle_sensitivity low, medium or high.

set_filament.name: Set filament
set_filament.description: Sets material, sub type, vendor and colour of a toolhead by hand, e.g. for spools without RFID. Not during a print.

sub_type.name: Sub type
sub_type.description: e.g. Silk, Matte, HF. Empty = none.

force.name: Overwrite official spool
force.description: Also overwrite the RFID data of an official Snapmaker spool.

options.spool_runout: Spool about to run out during print (Spoolman)

options.always: Always while the printer is on
